name: Unique Menu Icons
description: Gives every Gen 1 Pokemon its own unique party/menu icon instead of the vanilla shared body-type icons (QUADRUPED, BIRD, SNAKE, etc). Pick a color mode in Options > Mods: ORIGINAL (unique silhouettes, no palette changes), GBC RED (Gen 2 style red duotone, all species), or UNIQUE COLORS (each species in its real color). Modes 2 and 3 use a trueColor screen-zone patch instead of overriding any shared palette, so the title screen and Oak's intro are never affected. Icon art: MiniDex sprites by Chamber, Solo0993, Blue Emerald, Lake, Neslug and Pikachu25.
